reference: Current Gaussian coefficients from the exact v3 boundary; historical October 27 coefficient equivalence not assumed
scope: All 13 enabled round lens owners. On-axis signed Bz only. Nonround fields, particle trajectories and aberration kicks are not evaluated.
invariants: Captured source, controls, fixed physical turns including archived Objective 580+580, envelopes, polarity and tolerances unchanged; no candidate applied

quadrature.coil_operator: Original captured 12 by 12 circular-loop quadrature; no change in field tolerance

least_squares.isolated: s=<C,G>/<C,C> for each owner over all z; minimizes integral (s*C-G)^2 dz
least_squares.power_match: s=sqrt(integral G^2 dz/integral C^2 dz); preserves isolated integrated paraxial strength but not shape
least_squares.joint: Nonnegative least squares of signed sum of 13 current-scaled basis fields against sum of Gaussian fields; polarity fixed. Zeros are candidate endpoints, not applied inputs.
least_squares.joint_power: Joint LS currents uniformly rescaled to preserve all-round-owner total integral Bz^2, including cross terms; sacrifices the minimum LS error

winding_intervals.current_law: Uniform azimuthal ampere-turn density over the radial-axial winding rectangle
winding_intervals.method: Tensor Gauss-Legendre circular loops; complete elliptic-integral vector potential
winding_intervals.domain: Finite vacuum XYZ excluding closed winding volume
winding_intervals.numerical_scope: Quadrature convergence must be tested; no geometric iron-field or coherent qualification
